info.name: PowerChain Copilot API v1
info.description: Canonical Postman collection for PowerChain Copilot 1.0.0. It covers REST API v1, cookie-based sessions, AI/chat flows, governed approvals, market/network adapters, and developer smoke tests. Import an environment from api/postman/environments/. For deterministic development responses, run `pnpm api:mock` and select the Local Mock environment. The mock layer is representative only and must never be treated as live operational, financial, settlement, telemetry, or onchain evidence.
